shots.visual: A man stands calmly in a dimly lit underground corridor, surrounded by dozens of aggressive thugs holding machetes and iron pipes.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 給你們三秒鐘，跪下求饒。

shots.visual: A scarred gang leader sneers violently, pointing his shiny machete directly forward.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 死到臨頭還敢嘴硬！給我砍死他！

shots.visual: Multiple thugs charge forward at full speed with weapons raised under flashing neon lights.
Extremely sharp zoom into cold, lethal eyes filled with intense vengeance.
A blade slashes down hard, but the central figure sidesteps swiftly with terrifying agility.
A brutal hand grab twisting a thug's wrist backward with a violent crunching motion.
A thug flies across the hallway, violently crashing into a concrete wall.
Two assailants attack simultaneously; the central martial artist strikes both with swift elbow strikes.
A devastating throat-strike executed in shadow lighting, dropping an opponent instantly.
Looking at a live surveillance monitor displaying a chaotic single-handed beatdown inside a luxurious living room.
A man staring at the monitor screen with wide, bloodshot eyes, cold sweat dripping down his cheek.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 這怎麼可能？！他一個人擊倒三十個？！

shots.visual: A woman shivering in panic, clutching the man's sleeve with trembling hands.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 哥……我們是不是惹錯人了？

shots.visual: The man smashes a crystal glass onto the marble table in rage and fear.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 閉嘴！給老子加碼！叫所有人過去！

shots.visual: Pan across the dark corridor strewn with dozens of groaning thugs collapsed on the floor.
The dark-suited figure steps calmly across fallen bodies, slowly adjusting his suit jacket.
The gang leader crawls backward frantically in terror, bleeding and shaking.
A heavy black boot stomps down hard directly onto the gang leader's head against the floor.
The gang leader screaming in agony beneath the crushing weight.
A poised female executive steps into frame smoothly, offering an active smartphone.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 老闆，趙天豪的電話通了。

shots.visual: The main figure takes the phone with a deadly cold demeanor and holds it up.
A man holding a phone against his ear frantically, panting with high anxiety.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 得手了沒有？！陳峰死了沒有？！

shots.visual: A subtle, chilling smirk appears on the hero's face under dim neon lights.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 趙天豪，你派來的垃圾不太夠打。

shots.visual: The villain staggers backward three steps in shock, dropping his unlit cigar.
A woman shrinks into the leather couch, covering her mouth in horrified disbelief.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 不可能……那可是三十個殺手啊！

shots.visual: The hero presses his boot down harder onto the gang leader beneath him.
The assistant reports quietly while looking at a tablet in her hand.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 趙氏集團的最後海外帳戶已被解凍併購。

shots.visual: The trembling villain shouts hysterically into his phone receiver.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 你到底想怎樣？！要多少錢我都給！

shots.visual: Extreme close-up of dark ruthless eyes emitting terrifying bloodthirst.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 洗乾淨脖子，下個就是你。

shots.visual: The phone call cuts off to a dead tone sound; dark shadow falls over the villain's face.
The villain drops his phone and collapses powerlessly onto the floor in utter despair.
The main character crushed the phone into pieces with his bare hand, staring directly into camera with an intense death glare. Freeze frame.
